messages:
Aisha: Hey team — quick sync on HW partner offline-metering edge case. We're seeing duplicate batch uploads when devices reconnect after timezone DST switch. Anyone from eng seen this?
Liam: yeah saw 2 duplicate batches in staging yesterday. root cause looks like device local seqno resets when device clock jumps back.
Marta: duplicates cause negative adjustments in ledger during recon, we need dedupe/last-write policy.
Tom (partner): Device firmware uses local epoch for seq; we can change, but OTA takes weeks. Can we handle server side?
Aisha: goal: short-term server mitigation + long-term firmware plan. Options: idempotency by (device_id, day_utc, batch_id) or enforce monotonic counter.
Liam: implement idempotency token + signature verification. Also need clock skew tolerant window.
Ursula: confirm marketplace contract requires per-minute granularity. We must map device counters to SKU hourly buckets.
Marta: propose acceptance rules: if incoming batch overlaps existing window, run per-record dedupe using event_hash and timestamp with 5min skew.
Liam: I'll put up a PR with dedupe logic and a feature flag.
Tom: Partner can add batch_id on next firmware, for interim we'll include 'first_seen_ms' in the payload.
Diego: from legal: ensure signature scheme meets marketplace integrity requirements.
metering-bot: New test hook created: /tests/partner/offline-replay/; added sample payload
Aisha: sample payload (please use this shape for testing):
```json
{"device_id":"dev-001","batch_id":"b-20260328-1","first_seen_ms":1670000000000,"events": [{"seq":10,"usage":120}]}
```
Liam: noted — will write integration tests and backfill script to collapse duplicates.
Marta: For reconciliation: we'll tag disputed credits and run nightly backfill to correct negative deltas. Ops will review top 5 partners.
Ursula: timeline?
Aisha: short-term: server dedupe + feature flag by EOD tuesday (48h). firmware batch_id rollout: partner estimate 6 weeks. Backfill script by next Wed.
Tom: partner will prioritize OTA scheduling. I'll ping when firmware build is ready.
Aisha: thanks — can ppl drop ACKs? :thumbsup:
Liam: ACK
Marta: ACK
Tom: ACK
Ursula: ACK
Diego: ACK
